title: Invertibility of the completed-to-native compact-support scalar mate
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite-field datum $D$ with $\ell\ne D.p$, finite-type schemes $X,Y$ over $D.k$, a separated finite-type relative map $f:X\to Y$ and compactification $c:X\hookrightarrow Z\to Y$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Fix NativeGeometry and a finite unlifted coefficient index $E$ [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-data, def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let $a$ be a Change from its completed integral coefficient system to native coefficients, with $a.map(T)=C.integralMap$ for every scheme $T$ and normalized coefficient presentation $C$ at $E$ with its canonical embedding [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data, def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data]. Then the component of PurCompactSupport.comparison(a,c) at every integral finite-Tor constructible $K$ on $X$ is invertible [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. This is only a statement about the one ambient proper/open scalar mate; it asserts no finite-stage natural comparison or field coherence.

proof.text: Apply sfIntegralStandardTruncations to the constructible part of K. Its ambient boundedness supplies a lower bound n. The open-extension functor is exact, so its derived functor preserves IsGE n. Thus the ambient object j!K is bounded below; neither complete constructibility of j!K nor its finite-level Tor bounds is required.

proof.text: For arbitrary coefficient families and an open immersion, start with the proved invertibility of openRestrictionMap. Exact localization of its inverse open-adjunction mate identifies the localized mate with openRestriction.hom. Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_symm identifies the inverse scalar mate defining openComparison with the conjugate of the isomorphism proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedPullback.hom between the composite right adjoints. Conjugation preserves isomorphisms, proving openComparison invertible without invoking the unproved openComparison_isIso theorem.

theorem native_compact_support_scalar_mate_invertible [G : NativeGeometry.{u} l]
    (E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (a : PurCompactSupport.Change (PurCompactSupport.completed l
      (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)) (nativeCoefficients l))
    (ha : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u})
      (C : CoefficientPresentation l T (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) (embedding l E)),
      a.map T = C.integralMap l T)
    (K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X) :
    IsIso ((PurCompactSupport.comparison a c).app K.obj)
